# edge_cases_onx: onX import edge cases

`edge.json` is CalTopo-dialect GeoJSON (one folder, **Edge Cases**) generated by
`scripts/generate_edge_dataset.py`. Do not edit it by hand; regenerate it, and
`tests/test_onx_roundtrip_harness.py` fails if the file and the script drift apart.
It is the `edge` dataset of the round-trip harness (`scripts/onx_roundtrip.py`, see
`docs/ONX_TESTING.md`). Every markup is named `ZZTEST …` so leftovers in an onX account
are findable.

| Item(s) | Probes |
|---|---|
| `ZZTEST note 500/511/512/513/600/1000/3000` (waypoints) | onX's import note limit: a 617-char note was cut to 512 and a 3,000+ note dropped (2026-10-22). Numbered readable lines, exact lengths |
| `ZZTEST line note 511/512/513/3000` (lines) | the same limit on lines |
| `ZZTEST blank lines` | one and two blank lines between paragraphs |
| `ZZTEST url` | a URL with `?`, `&` and `#` |
| `ZZTEST literal tags` | literal `<desc>` and `<Lake>`, `<` and `>` in a note |
| `ZZTEST Peak #3`, `Rock & Roll`, `Wow!`, `Camp (lower)`, `O'Neil's Spring`, `trailing space ` | name characters Cairn sanitizes (`# & !`) or keeps (`( ) '`), and a trailing space |
| `ZZTEST dashed line` | CalTopo dash pattern `M0 -1 L0 1,,8,F` -> onX `dash` |
| `ZZTEST wide line` | CalTopo `stroke-width` 6 -> onX weight `6.0` |
| `ZZTEST filled area` | a polygon with fill `#FF00FF` at opacity 0.3 |

What Cairn itself does to these before onX sees them (CalTopo GeoJSON is HTML-capable, so
notes are HTML-cleaned): `<desc>` and `<Lake>` are removed as tags (`5 < 6 and 7 > 4`
survives), two blank lines collapse to one, `#`, `&` and `!` are dropped from names (listed
in RUNBOOK.md under "Renamed for onX"), and the trailing space is trimmed.
